declaration.population: all288 markets/day;2592 per arm/J or X,9 previously consumed dates; no outcome-based exclusions; guards trained on8 dates
declaration.baseline: same continuous-basis, single-order execution approximation as prior exit studies; not native incremental LZ/live parity
declaration.controls: baseline and late_reserved freshly replayed every day; both exact to prior win/fill/request artifacts
declaration.audit: baseline only, every normal desired invocation from60s; consecutive identical feasibility states compressed into episodes, all predicates plus first blocking reason; durations are decision-sampled states, not continuously observable queue availability
declaration.soft_exit: late_reserved plus reducing-side PM90 cutoff lower by .01 score units during60..240; preserve Binance,GS,price,book,notional,room,stop; new threshold-crossing events only in this interval
declaration.budget_exit: soft_exit plus one tick strictly inside spread during180..240 when abs known net>=10; cumulative submitted concessions <=$0.25/window including all uncertain orders, no refunds for cancels/rejections; cap at send and floor lots; retain paid-for existing order
declaration.budget_limits: bounds deliberate quote-price concession versus originating unshifted quote only; not adverse selection, total exit loss, or causal incremental cost; never subtract twice from cash PnL
declaration.marginal_entry: late_reserved after60; before60 use premium .01 score per625 increase in possible inventory radius squared; clip quantity using fresh score minus PM90 line, pending both sides independently including cancellation grace, all lanes and retry recheck; preserves same-price feasible remainder; no settlement forecast/dollar-score interpretation

timing.stress_X: Nov3 only,X plus80/22/95/300ms delays; full-path paired replay,assumptions not calibration

null.design: shared paired day sign flips, sign-invariant RMS max-T, paired bootstrap

declaration.multiplicity: 3new policies,one fixed setting each after prior consumed-data selection; no tuning based on this run
declaration.limits: historical fill clocks uncalibrated; no independent validation, no market impact/full native OMS, no live-achievable claim
